about: A box item's menu stays up as in the game, and answering it doesn't hold the player. rathena runs an item's script through a stand-in hidden NPC whose vanish comes with the menu. Stock rathena has freed the script by then (pc_useitem), so the Dungeon Ticket's menu (select in its item script) gets no reply; Class4-RO keeps its scripts and answers (its Metal Weapon Box). Main closed the menu with the stand-in, so no box could be answered; now the menu stays, and after OK the player walks.
